items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: And he took us and learned us how to drill, regular formation drill, and he organized the band.

ctx.x: Did none of your folks play music? Your father or mother? No one in my family played music. Any brothers or sisters that were interested? I have no brothers or sisters. Do you remember the first music you heard? What kind of music you heard in St. Louis?

Well the first music I heard was what they had a Cudded Band called the Nice Epiphance Cudded Band. And I started playing in that band as a drummer. That was back in 1906. Did you have any lessons on drums? Did you just pick it up? No, see it was at that time they called it the Nice Epiphance Cadets. It's the same at the present time you'd have the Boy Scouts. Oh yes, yes. You know, but just the kids in the neighborhood. They used to all, and this nice epiphance was an organization that took all the kids off the…
